title: Lock schemas/: the contracts the gate applies are under the lockfile
objective: Put schemas/*.json under INTEGRITY_PATHS so a schema edit, addition or removal without a re-sign is drift; carry schemas/ into the scratch clones that run the working gate.
business_value: The gate applies schemas (check_schema) and the drift walker validates every shipped record against them; a loosened required set or widened enum today changes what is accepted with no re-sign in the diff.
in_scope: tests: edit / add / remove a schema without re-sign is drift
out_of_scope: examples/ (validated by CI, not locked -- separate Issue)
acceptance_criteria: repo refuses a schema edit without re-sign naming the file
repo refuses an added or removed schema file without re-sign
all existing tests green; compose green in both shapes

rollback.method: revert the squash commit via PR

note: Lands IN_PROGRESS by design; reconciled by the next WP's branch.
landing_not_on_ledger: Withdrawn before any PR: Issue #24's premise was false (schemas/*.json locked since BADF-WP-0007) and its Evidence line was not measured. Recorded, not deleted.
